summary: Native Android release 0.5.20 (versionCode 22): replaces the 0.5.19 Play internal draft before any rollout. Adds what merged after 0.5.19: device identity on pairing and session auth (#365, device_identity_v1: install id, name, model, OS and app version; a re-pair supersedes the old session) and the Home screen machine rows with transport state (#366).

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts of each shipped feature are covered by that feature's own manifest.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own OTA and build lanes; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API change; the backend contracts these Android features use are covered by their own manifests.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump.

notExercised: The Play internal rollout and install on a phone (next step, by the user).
